verdict.rationale: v0 supports iterative refinement via chat-based follow-up prompts, auto-fixing errors/builds, and branch/version management (Duplicate Branch, Fix Conflicts, Fix CI) that suggest non-destructive iteration, but there's no explicit documentation or evidence describing regression protection or 'don't break existing features' guarantees during follow-up prompts. Community feedback also notes generic/repetitive design output on repeated prompting, hinting at limits to creative iteration. missing for 10: explicit evidence of regression-safe editing/diffing across follow-ups, hands-on testimony confirming prior functionality remains intact after iterative prompts, and any versioning/rollback safeguards tied specifically to prompt-based edits.
